svg.title: Project 01: Resilient S3-SQS-DLQ Pipeline
svg.text: Event-Driven Storage / SSE-KMS CMK / Confused Deputy Defense / Poison Pill Isolation
• Poison Pill Isolation: isolates corrupt data
• Confused Deputy Defense: SQS policy restricts aws:SourceArn to bucket ARN.
• Envelope Encryption: KMS CMK encrypts payload data at rest in S3 and SQS.
• Automated Redrive: Corrupted payloads isolated to prevent consumer crashes.
• Poison Pill Alert: CloudWatch Alarm fires when DLQ ApproximateNumberOfMessages > 0.
• Inspection & Debug: SRE inspects DLQ message payload to identify schema errors.
• Redrive to Source: SQS StartMessageMoveTask replays healed messages to primary queue.
